item.description:
fairy cursor updates itself from now on, and you choose how it follows.

  • updates: menu bar → check for updates…. it also looks by itself about once a day, and a new version waits as a small dot on the menu bar icon instead of interrupting you. settings → updates switches the looking off
  • following: settings → general → following. close stays right by the cursor, calm glides after it (as before), lively swings and leans as you move, like the demo on the website
